Market today: July saw a significant "momentum trade wipeout" and the S&P 500's first July decline since 2014. This indicates a tough month for high-growth tech/chip names, despite a "hopeful note" at month-end.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses, needing immediate attention due to decay and margin amplification. QQQI (-5.97%) is also a SELL. QQQ (-3.73%) and SMH (-15.06%) are on TRIM status and close to their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on QQQ and SMH around their stops. Monitor for any signs of stabilization in the broader tech/chip sector after the recent "wipeout."

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with margin amplifying drawdowns.
plays: SMH: Trim if it breaks 540. It's currently at 540.53, so this is a critical level to watch.
QQQ: Trim if it breaks 670. Current price 687.99, so watch closely for this support level.
SOXL/SPAL: Review your stops for these leveraged ETFs. Their current stops are far above current prices and need adjustment to protect capital given their massive losses and decay.
